summary: 37 units reviewed; 4 errors, 25 minor. Errors: Hindi bare कषाय (u12), Hindi उल्लिखित for ullikhet (u18), wrong gender on siddhena (u16), ghṛtamaṇḍa defined in gloss (u27). All 17 text_flags judged plausible; src keeps printed forms; only unit 20 word row uses the printed non-word (ādhmāya) instead of the corrected form. Unit 30 brackets handled sensibly; units 7/26/29/32 add no verb in English (Hindi unit 24 adds one). Regrouping: suggest merging 25+26 and 31+32 (sentence continues); 28+29 are parallel and share iṣṭaḥ. Confidence ratings honest.
glossary_suggestions: kaṣāya (decoction) in Hindi: use काढ़ा, never bare कषाय; keep niryūha/kvātha apart in notes (OPEN).
utkleśa / utkliṣṭa / utkliśya / samudīrṇa: fix one rendering (draft mixes 'stirring up', 'agitated', 'aroused'); suggest 'agitation/agitated' for ut-√kliś and 'aroused' for samudīrṇa.
Unstated nouns after adjectives (tīkṣṇaiḥ etc.): English '(ones)', Hindi plain adjective plural, no gender in gram.
kṣāma = lean (Hindi कृश); ghṛtamaṇḍa = ghee-maṇḍa, no definition; kṣāra keep as kṣāra.
Spelling variants vasti/basti and -rtt-/-rt- normalised in words: record once in the glossary rather than per unit.
avacārayet = 'should administer' / प्रयोग करे; bhāgika = 'pertaining to the upper/lower part'.
